essence: Siddhalakshmi's right hands embody the bestowal of boon and fearlessness.
The verse offers reverence to Siddhalakshmi as a universally worshipped deity who grants desire and stands upon lotus and corpse.
By the Kaula tradition and the true guru's compassion, may liberation be granted for the pleasure of Shambhu.
